description: Figure 6, labeled "Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets," is a pie chart that visually represents the proportional contribution of different data sources to the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation datasets. The chart is divided into five distinct colored segments, each corresponding to a specific data source and labeled with its percentage share. The largest segment, colored blue, represents ENTITYQUEST at 26.0%. The second largest, colored red, is HOTPOTQA at 24.2%. The third largest, colored yellow, is POPQA at 21.6%. The fourth, colored orange, is TRIVIAQA at 22.7%. The smallest segment, colored green, represents TREC at 1.9%. A fifth, very small segment, colored teal, represents WEBQUESTIO at 3.6%. Each segment is clearly labeled with its source name and percentage value, and the chart is presented without any additional visual emphasis such as exploded slices or percentage labels inside the segments.
